localOwner.name: aw_session
localOwner.description: Eight-hour, process-local Owner session for explicit local/legacy profiles, created by that profile's verified SSO callback or POST /api/session (loopback only). HttpOnly; Secure for HTTPS; logout revokes it. Managed account and regional Guest hosts use their separate credentials below.

accountOwner.name: aw_account
accountOwner.description: Opaque, Workspace-bound regional Owner continuity grant issued after verified TiDB Account sign-in. Host-only, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict and Secure on HTTPS. Browser-session cookie with no absolute server expiry; logout or regional policy denial revokes access. Existing grants survive Region restart and Global outage. Not a Workspace Key and never inferred from a Workspace URL.

guestOwner.name: aw_guest
guestOwner.description: Opaque regional Guest Owner session issued by POST /api/auth/guest when enabled. Host-only, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Workspace-bound and subject to its absolute Guest expiry. Guest logout revokes access and schedules scoped cleanup. Never grants access to an account or another Guest Workspace.

regionalAccess.description: Audience-bound regional access. Checked against Region-local Key, grant, family, denial and policy checkpoints; never introspected at Global.

regionalRefresh.name: Authorization
regionalRefresh.description: Refresh <credential>, bound to the enrolled client key and rotating nonce. Requires DPoP proof. Never sent to Global.

region.description: Provider-assigned data location; may be automatic and is distinct from the Workspace Region.

provider.description: Missing on legacy local resources. PostgreSQL-compatible databases support NUMERIC values of up to 28–29 significant digits. Provider compatibility limits apply.
